flow_ref: User story (not in the OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: Email sending exists in NotificationSmsEmailJob for companies (idType B), but for ENA/RD*/DN* reminders; there is no email with court summons details.
note: Story: send an email reminder with court summons details to unique companies. Status blank, no demo_remark. Synonyms tried: state court, adjudicat, court mention, mention_date, hearing, court_case, courtreminder; in all six repos. DOS = DataHive/LTA cannot be confirmed from the repo. Email sending exists for idType B recipients (ocmsadminprivateapi/src/main/java/com/ocmsintranet/cronservice/framework/workflows/notification_sms_email/jobs/NotificationSmsEmailJob.java:354, :378) but for ENA/RD*/DN* reminders; stages DN1, DN2, DR3 skip the EMAIL channel (no template, ocmsadminprivateapi/src/main/java/com/ocmsintranet/cronservice/framework/workflows/notification_sms_email/helpers/NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:312-315). The existing eNotification mechanism (ocmsadminprivateapi/src/main/java/com/ocmsintranet/cronservice/framework/workflows/notification_sms_email/helpers/NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java) selects notices at stages ENA/RD1/RD2/RR3/DN1/DN2/DR3 using the ENOTEDAYS parameter per stage (ocmsadminprivateapi/src/main/java/com/ocmsintranet/cronservice/framework/workflows/notification_sms_email/helpers/NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:1108-1114), not court notices by court mention date; it is switched off in prod (cron.notification.enabled=false, ocmsadminprivateapi/src/main/resources/cron-schedules-prod.properties:236); the real server value cannot be verified from the repo. email.enableSmtp=false in application-prod.properties:80 (real server value cannot be verified from the repo).
recommendation: Evidence 33%. Do not claim the State Courts/court reminder feature; only the generic eNotification mechanism exists.

steps.step: Company email addresses are obtained from DOS
steps.detail: The code refreshes contacts from DataHive (ocmsadminprivateapi/src/main/java/com/ocmsintranet/cronservice/framework/workflows/notification_sms_email/helpers/NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:2461, called at ocmsadminprivateapi/src/main/java/com/ocmsintranet/cronservice/framework/workflows/notification_sms_email/jobs/NotificationSmsEmailJob.java:186-188). DOS = DataHive/LTA cannot be confirmed from the repo; only ENA/RD*/DN* notices, not court notices.

steps.step: The system identifies unique companies for the emails of each batch
steps.detail: Recipients with idType B are routed to email (ocmsadminprivateapi/src/main/java/com/ocmsintranet/cronservice/framework/workflows/notification_sms_email/jobs/NotificationSmsEmailJob.java:354) and combineNotices merges notices of the same recipient (ocmsadminprivateapi/src/main/java/com/ocmsintranet/cronservice/framework/workflows/notification_sms_email/helpers/NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:2151, ocmsadminprivateapi/src/main/java/com/ocmsintranet/cronservice/framework/workflows/notification_sms_email/jobs/NotificationSmsEmailJob.java:191). The input is non-court notices only; no uniqueness per company beyond that merge.

steps.step: The system sends an email containing the court summons details
steps.detail: Email is sent via notificationHelper.sendEmail (ocmsadminprivateapi/src/main/java/com/ocmsintranet/cronservice/framework/workflows/notification_sms_email/jobs/NotificationSmsEmailJob.java:388, def ocmsadminprivateapi/src/main/java/com/ocmsintranet/cronservice/framework/workflows/notification_sms_email/helpers/NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:556) using templates per ENA/RD*/DN* stage (ocmsadminprivateapi/src/main/java/com/ocmsintranet/cronservice/framework/workflows/notification_sms_email/helpers/NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:459-468); no court summons/mention date content. DB template content cannot be verified from the repo. The job is switched off in prod (ocmsadminprivateapi/src/main/resources/cron-schedules-prod.properties:236).
